name: Power Finance Corporation Ltd
description: Power Finance Corporation Ltd (PFC) is a specialized non-banking financial institution operating in retail credit, housing finance, and asset-backed financing. revenue_breakup.desc: Individual housing credit for salaried and self-employed residential property buyers.

Project construction funding for residential real estate developments.

Extensive branch network deeply embedded in high-growth suburban and Tier-2 mortgage corridors.

bearish_risks: Sharp increase in wholesale borrowing costs narrowing net interest spreads.
Aggressive mortgage rate competition from top private and public sector commercial banks.
